content.text: Yerusɑlɛmu, wunɛ wi Yinni Gusunɔ u tii ɡɔsiɑ,
ɑ dom yɑndo kpɑ wunɛn dɑm mu wurɑmɑ,
kpɑ ɑ wunɛn burɑ yɑ̃nu doke.
Domi be bɑ ǹ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑmɔ,
ben ɡoo kun mɑɑ duɔ wunɛ sɔɔ.
A seewo ɑ tii tuɑ kpɑrɑ,
ɑ wunɛn yoo yɔni potɑ wunɛn wĩirun di,
kpɑ ɑ sinɑ wunɛn sinɑ ɡɔnɑ sɔɔ.

content: Yinni Gusunɔ u Yerusɑlɛmu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ rɑɑ nun dɔrɑwɑ ɡobi sɑri. Mɛyɑ kon mɑɑ nun yɑkiɑ n kun kɑ ɡobi.
Yellu, nɛn tɔmbu bɑ dɑ Eɡibitiɔ bɑ sɔru di mi. Yen biru, Asiriɡibɑ nɑ ben temɔ bɑ bu dɑm dɔre kɑ wɔbiɑ.
Tɛ̃, mbɑ kon ko. Wee Bɑbiloniɡibɑ nɑ bɑ bu ɡurɑ kɑm sɔɔ, mɑ bɑ kuuki mɔ̀ bɑ nɛn yĩsiru ɡɑri kɑm ɡerusimɔ sɑɑ bɑɑyere.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru, nɛn tɔmbu bɑ koo ɡiɑ wi nɑ sɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ bu tubu mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ ɡerumɔ nɑ mɔ̀, nɛ wee, nɑ wee.

content.text: Annɑ ɑ wɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ bu dɑm koosiɑmɔ,
be, be bɑ wee ɡuunun di bɑ lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ kpɑrɑmɔ.
Bɑ Siɔni bɔri yɛndu kɑ fɑɑbɑn ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔmɔ bɑ mɔ̀,
Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni u bɑndu dii.
Wee, be bɑ rɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru kɔ̃su
bɑ nɔɔɡiru sue,
bɑ kuuki mɔ̀ kɑ nuku dobu.
Domi bɑ wɑ kɑ nɔni
mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Siɔni yɑkiɑm wee.
Yerusɑlɛmun bɑnsu,
ɑ kuuki koowo kɑ nuku dobu,
domi Yinni Gusunɔ u win tɔmbun nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ.
U Yerusɑlɛmu yɑkiɑ.
U koo win dɑm kɑ win dɛɛrɑru
bwesenu kpuro sɔ̃ɔsi,
kpɑ bu wɑ hɑnduniɑn ɡoonu nnɛ kpuro sɔɔ
mɑ u win tɔmbu fɑɑbɑ kuɑ.
Bɛɛ be i Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃nu sɔɔwɑ i kɑ wee,
i tii dɛɛrɑsio.
Kpɑ i se i yɑri Bɑbilonin di.
I ku ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu bɑbɑ ni nu disi mɔ.
Ì n yɑriɔ, i ǹ ko i yɑri kɑ sɛndɑru
nɡe be bɑ kpikiru suɔ.
Domi Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u ko n bɛɛ kɔ̃su
biruɔ kɑ wuswɑɑɔ.
wee nɛn sɔm kowo u koo nɑsɑrɑ wɑ.
U koo se u ko tɔn boko.
Nɡe mɛ u tɔn dɑbiru nɑndɑsiɑ
yèn sɔ̃ win wuswɑɑ yɑ kɔsɑ wɑhɑlɑn sɔ̃,
mɑ win wɑsi yi ǹ mɑɑ kɑ tɔnuɡii weenɛ,
nɡe mɛyɑ u koo bwese dɑbinu biti kpɛ̃ɛ,
kpɑ sinɑmbu bu kpɑnɑ bu ɡɑri ɡere win wuswɑɑɔ.
Domi yèn fɑɑɡi bɑ ǹ bu kuɑre, bɑ koo ye wɑ,
kpɑ ye bɑ ǹ nɔɔre, n bu yeeri.
